scores.claim_text: Desktop Metal operates manufacturing/HQ in Burlington, MA (~110,000 sq ft).
scores.M_value: n_facilities=4 (Burlington x2, Lexington, Woburn — all greater Boston / Middlesex County)
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms 4 Desktop Metal facilities registered in MA, including 1 NORTH AVE Burlington (the HQ) plus a second Burlington site (63 Third Ave), and Lexington/Woburn satellite sites. Strong corroboration of the company's MA operating footprint.

scores.claim_text: EnvisionTEC US LLC operates Dearborn, MI manufacturing facility (FDA-regulated dental products).
scores.M_value: n_facilities=2 (Dearborn @ 15162 S Commerce Dr, Ferndale @ 1100 Hilton Rd)
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms the Dearborn EnvisionTEC facility named in the whistleblower disclosure exists at the implied address, plus a second site in Ferndale. The resin/curing operations are exactly the kind of process that registers with EPA. Backs up the existence of the facility named in legal/whistleblower context.

scores.claim_text: Desktop Metal supported by over 1,000 patents/applications.
scores.interpretation: USPTO ODP shows 115 granted patents pre-cutoff with at least one match in claimed categories ({'binder_jet_metal': 174, 'polymer_dental': 1, 'ceramics_sands': 9}). Real portfolio exists.

scores.claim_text: ExOne European HQ operating facility in Gersthofen, Germany under multi-year lease.
scores.M_value: total_hits=296 across SEC filings; ExOne Co (CIK 0001561627) and Desktop Metal both file extensively referencing ExOne
scores.interpretation: ExOne was an independent NYSE-listed binder-jet 3D-printing OEM (CIK 0001561627) prior to its 2021 acquisition by Desktop Metal — its 10-Ks/8-Ks plus DM's post-acquisition references generate 296 hits. The German Gersthofen facility itself is foreign so not directly checkable via EPA FRS (per recipe applies_when), but the entity's reality and the legal-proceeding references to the ExOne Merger fully corroborate the existence of an active operating subsidiary with the disclosed lease.

scores.claim_text: Stratasys Ltd. merger agreement signed May 25, 2023 (subsequently terminated).
scores.M_value: total_hits=33 in Stratasys filings (default forms only show 2 in the two 20-Fs; expanded with 6-K shows 33). Stratasys is an Israeli foreign issuer that files 20-F + 6-K rather than 10-K/8-K.
scores.interpretation: Stratasys's own SEC filings extensively disclose Desktop Metal: 2 mentions in 20-F annuals (2022 + 2023) and 33 total when 6-K current reports are included. Per heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer ADR: 0-2 = NORMAL), even the default-form figure passes; the expanded number strongly corroborates the merger and its termination. Counterparty disclosure is real.

scores.claim_text: Desktop Metal brand has external footprint in US-listed-filer disclosures.
scores.M_value: total_hits=362 across SEC filings; appears in DM's own filings, Trine SPAC predecessor, ExOne, Stratasys, and others
scores.interpretation: 362 hits substantially exceeds the >=10 PASS threshold for external_brand_validation. The brand has a real footprint across SPAC predecessor (Trine), acquisition target (ExOne), prospective merger partner (Stratasys), and other unrelated filers. No deception signal.

scores.claim_text: Desktop Health / EnvisionTEC commercializes FDA-regulated dental products (Flexcera resins, PCA4000 curing box).
scores.interpretation: Recipe misfit. Drugs@FDA covers NDAs/ANDAs; dental resins and curing boxes are 510(k)-cleared medical devices in the FDA Device 510(k) database, not Drugs@FDA. The 0-result here does not contradict the claim — it simply indicates the wrong M-source for this regulatory pathway. The whistleblower disclosure itself (acknowledging FDA-notified voluntary recalls of Flexcera and PCA4000) functions as a direct admission of an FDA-regulated product line, so the claim is internally consistent even though the chosen M-source cannot validate.

scores.claim_text: ExOne (acquired subsidiary) operates US manufacturing/operations sites in Pennsylvania.
scores.M_value: n_facilities=1 (THE EXONE CO @ 127 INDUSTRY BLVD, IRWIN, PA — Westmoreland County)
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms an active EPA-registered ExOne industrial facility in Irwin, PA (Westmoreland County, the same area as ExOne's pre-acquisition North Huntingdon HQ). Sand/binder-jet operations exactly match the kind of industrial process that registers with EPA. Strong PASS.
